limitations: Finance prefers OpenFEC totals; on API rate-limits falls back to FEC weball bulk downloads (same filings, no API key).

Ensemble predictive mixture OOF-scored; learned weights favor state_space / ridge when static pymc CRPS does not earn mass. pymc_dynamic competes as a separate stack candidate after OOF freeze.
